```{r}
#| output: false
#| echo: false
library(readxl)
library(knitr)
df_raw <- read_excel("../../../Desktop/Mentalism/3-BayesianDataAnalysis/Cocosiru/資料/Hirosaki2.xlsx", sheet = "統合_最終")
df <- df_raw[, c("受付番号", "受診日年齢", "性別", "Weight", "BP", "FLCΣ", "BP備考", "判別式", "LOX-1_H", "LAB_H", "LOX-index_H", "タイプ", "多様性", paste0("item", 1:18))]

# BP の整理
df <- df[is.na(df$`BP備考`), ]
df$BP <- ifelse(df$BP < 0, -1 * df$BP, df$BP)
df$判別式 <- as.numeric(gsub("[()]", "", df$判別式))

# 年代を作成（10で割って切り捨てた後、10をかけて年代を表現）
df$年代 <- paste0(floor(df$受診日年齢/10)*10, "代")
df$年代 <- factor(df$年代,
                  levels = c("20代", "30代", "40代", "50代", "60代", "70代", "80代"),
                  ordered = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| output: false
#| echo: false
library(dplyr)
# ストレスチェックの前処理

item_sum <- df$item1 + df$item2 + df$item3
score_activity <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x == 3 ~ 5,
    x >= 4 & x <= 5 ~ 4,
    x >= 6 & x <= 7 ~ 3,
    x >= 8 & x <= 9 ~ 2,
    x >= 10 & x <= 12 ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_  # それ以外の値の場合はNA
  )
}
df$活気 <- score_activity(item_sum)

item_sum <- df$item4 + df$item5 + df$item6
score_activity_m <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x == 3 ~ 1,
    x >= 4 & x <= 5 ~ 2,
    x >= 6 & x <= 7 ~ 3,
    x >= 8 & x <= 9 ~ 4,
    x >= 10 & x <= 12 ~ 5,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_  # それ以外の値の場合はNA
  )
}
score_activity_f <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x == 3 ~ 1,
    x >= 4 & x <= 5 ~ 2,
    x >= 6 & x <= 8 ~ 3,
    x >= 9 & x <= 10 ~ 4,
    x >= 11 & x <= 12 ~ 5,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_  # それ以外の値の場合はNA
  )
}
df$イライラ感 <- ifelse(
  df$性別 == 1,
  score_activity_m(item_sum),  # 男性用の関数
  score_activity_f(item_sum)   # 女性用の関数
)

item_sum <- df$item7 + df$item8 + df$item9
score_activity_m <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x == 3 ~ 1,
    x == 4 ~ 2,
    x >= 5 & x <= 7 ~ 3,
    x >= 8 & x <= 10 ~ 4,
    x >= 11 & x <= 12 ~ 5,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_  # それ以外の値の場合はNA
  )
}
score_activity_f <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x == 3 ~ 1,
    x >= 4 & x <= 5 ~ 2,
    x >= 6 & x <= 8 ~ 3,
    x >= 9 & x <= 11 ~ 4,
    x == 12 ~ 5,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_  # それ以外の値の場合はNA
  )
}
df$疲労感 <- ifelse(
  df$性別 == 1,
  score_activity_m(item_sum),  # 男性用の関数
  score_activity_f(item_sum)   # 女性用の関数
)

item_sum <- df$item10 + df$item11 + df$item12
score_activity_m <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x == 3 ~ 1,
    x == 4 ~ 2,
    x >= 5 & x <= 7 ~ 3,
    x >= 8 & x <= 9 ~ 4,
    x >= 10 & x <= 12 ~ 5,

}
score_activity_f <- function(x) {
  case_when(

df$不安感 <- ifelse(

item_sum <- df$item13 + df$item14 + df$item15 + df$item16 + df$item17 + df$item18
score_activity_m <- function(x) {
```

## 各項目データに対する項目反応モデリング

### データ長形式化

```{r}
df_1PL <- df[, c("受付番号", "BP", "FLCΣ", paste0("item", 1:18))]
colnames(df_1PL) <- c("id", "BP", "FLCΣ", paste0("item", 1:18))

library(tidyr)

df_1PL_long <- df_1PL %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("item"),
    names_to = "item",
    values_to = "response"
  )

df_1PL_long$res <- ifelse(df_1PL_long$response > 3, 1, 0)

kable(head(df_1PL_long[6:13,]))
```


### 2PL モデル

次のモデルは重すぎて実行できず．

```r
library(brms)

formula_2PL <- bf(
  res ~ exp(loggamma) * eta,
  loggamma ~ 1 + (1|item),
  eta ~ 1 + (1|item) + (1|id),
  nl = TRUE
)

fit_2PL <- brm(
  formula = formula_2PL,
  data = df_1PL_long,
  family = brmsfamily("bernoulli", link = "logit"),
  chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 5000
)
```

### 1PL モデル

```{r}
library(brms)

formula_1PL <- bf(
  res ~ 1 + (1|item) + (1|BP)
)

fit_1PL <- brm(
  formula = formula_1PL,
  data = df_1PL_long,
  family = brmsfamily("bernoulli", link = "logit"),
  chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 5000
)
```

```{r}
summary(fit_1PL)
```

```{r}
plot(fit_1PL)
```

#### 項目パラメータ

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ranef_item <- ranef(fit_1PL)$item
posterior_means <- ranef_item[,1,1]
lower_bounds <- ranef_item[,3,1]
upper_bounds <- ranef_item[,4,1]
plot_df_item <- data.frame(
  item = rownames(ranef_item),
  mean = posterior_means,
  lower = lower_bounds,
  upper = upper_bounds
)
p_PL1 <- ggplot(plot_df_item, aes(x = mean, y = item)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), width = 0.2) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Posterior Means and 95% Credible Intervals for Items",
       x = "Posterior Estimate",
       y = "Item")
p_PL1
```

```{r}
item2_3 <- df_1PL_long[df_1PL_long$item %in% c("item2", "item3"),]
summary(item2_3$response)
```

ほとんどの人が高い値を答えた．

```{r}
item4_9 <- df_1PL_long[df_1PL_long$item %in% c("item4", "item5", "item6", "item7", "item8", "item9"),]
summary(item4_9$response)
```

```{r}
item15_18 <- df_1PL_long[df_1PL_long$item %in% c("item15", "item16", "item17", "item18"),]
summary(item15_18$response)
```

ほとんどの人が低い値を答えた．

#### 個人パラメータ

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ranef_BP <- ranef(fit_1PL)$BP
posterior_means <- ranef_BP[,1,1]
lower_bounds <- ranef_BP[,3,1]
upper_bounds <- ranef_BP[,4,1]
plot_df_BP <- data.frame(
  BP = rownames(ranef_BP),
  mean = posterior_means,
  lower = lower_bounds,
  upper = upper_bounds
)
p_PL1 <- ggplot(plot_df_BP, aes(x = mean, y = BP)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), width = 0.2) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Posterior Means and 95% Credible Intervals for BP",
       x = "Posterior Estimate",
       y = "BP")
p_PL1
```

基本的に，BP は項目反応には関係ない．しかし，一部の人だけ高い回帰係数が推定されている．

## BP の高低と項目反応

### BP の層別

```r
df$BP_level <- case_when(
  df$BP > 0.9 ~ 3,
  df$BP > 0.6 & df$BP <= 0.9 ~ 2,
  df$BP <= 0.6 ~ 1
)
length(df[df$BP_level == 3, ]$BP)/dim(df)[1]
length(df[df$BP_level == 2, ]$BP)/dim(df)[1]
length(df[df$BP_level == 1, ]$BP)/dim(df)[1]
```

### 1PL モデル

```r
library(brms)

formula_1PL <- bf(
  活気 ~ 1 + (1 | BP_level)
)

fit_1PL <- brm(
  formula = formula_1PL,
  data = df,
  family = brmsfamily("categorical"),
  chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 5000
)
```

```r
summary(fit_1PL)
```

```r
ranef(fit_1PL)
```
